verdict: Leads surged this week; Google spend with zero returns needs fixing now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 120 leads entirely through Meta at a cost per lead of $24.18, and this past week alone saw a 58.82% jump in leads alongside a 23.24% drop in cost per lead — a genuine improvement. However, the final three days of the week showed lead volume stalling, so that trend is being watched closely. In parallel, Google Ads consumed $1,748.62 — 60% of total spend — and recorded zero conversions over the full 28-day window; that budget is being redirected. On the pipeline side, all 120 leads arrived but none have progressed to a booked appointment, which points to a follow-up gap rather than an ads issue, and that intake process is being tightened now.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all through Meta
cost per lead this period, down 23% week over week
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions recorded

watch_item.issue: 120 leads in the pipeline with zero appointments booked, indicating a follow-up or intake gap.
watch_item.fix: The lead intake and follow-up sequence is being audited and corrected this week to ensure leads move forward after they arrive.
